snippet.title: $1,000 Solar Setup vs My Electric Bill
snippet.description:
Let's find out if a small power station or solar generator setup can save you money on your electric bill!

☀️ SOLAR CALCULATOR - estimate savings for your home, get free quotes from local solar companies
https://www.solarreviews.com/solar-estimator?aff=162985&cam=851

📈 SPREADSHEET

• EcoFlow Delta 3 Plus - https://amzn.to/3Qolc29
• Renogy 200W Solar Panel - https://amzn.to/3CQGxOM (a good option but a cheaper alternative would be two 100W panels)
• Solar extension cable - https://amzn.to/3QiVGvy (again, a good option but not the cheapest)
• XT60i adapter cable - https://amzn.to/3QjHy4U
• Govee Smart Plug - https://amzn.to/3Qj7MVo

🔢 MY FREE SOLAR TOOLS
• Solar Panel Tilt Angle Calculator ➔ https://footprinthero.com/solar-panel-tilt-angle-calculator
• Solar Panel Azimuth Angle Calculator ➔ https://footprinthero.com/solar-panel-azimuth-angle-calculator
• Peak Sun Hours Calculator ➔ https://footprinthero.com/peak-sun-hours-calculator

👋 CONNECT WITH FOOTPRINT HERO!
• Blog ➔ https://footprinthero.com/
• TikTok ➔ https://www.tiktok.com/@footprinthero
• Instagram ➔ https://www.instagram.com/footprint.hero/

Note: This video is not sponsored. I purchased all the solar equipment shown in this video with my own money.


~
This solar setup relies heavily on 2 overlooked features available in some EcoFlow power stations, such as the EcoFlow Delta 3 Plus: TOU (Time-of-Use) mode and Self-powered mode. (Two other EcoFlow power stations I own, the River 2 and River 3, have a variation of these features called "Energy management" and "Backup reserve" respectively.)

Using a solar generator setup to lower your electric bill doesn't seem to be a popular use case, but I figured I'd give it a shot since power stations and solar generators are oftentimes sitting around collecting dust when they're not being used for backup power or power on-the-go. And EcoFlow does market their TOU and Self-powered modes as being good for this sort of thing, after all.

The appliances I powered weren't optimal in terms of energy usage. Some of you may be able to use a setup like this to run appliances that use 2-3x the energy on a daily basis, and therefore offset with solar -- or shift the pricing period of -- 2-3x the energy that I was able to. If you're doing this sort of thing with your power station / solar generator, I'd be curious to hear what sort of savings you're seeing!

~

I lost 40 pounds eating only 2 meals a day. No programs. No gimmicks. No one to pay. Here's exactly what I eat — every brand, every gram, every meal. Links to everything below.
THE SYSTEM:

Wake 4AM — black coffee, one Thorn electrolyte packet
4-5AM — time in the Word and prayer
5-6:30AM — six mile walk, every single day
6:30-7:30AM — stretching, then the Forge
7:30AM — Meal One
5PM — Meal Two
2,000 calories total. That's the whole secret.

MEAL ONE — ~1,000 calories

10oz Kirkland organic 85/15 ground beef
4 farm fresh eggs — Parmesan scramble
Avocado oil for cooking
Fleur de sel French salt
Thorn whey protein + creatine shake
Thorn electrolytes with 16oz water

MEAL TWO — ~1,000 calories

10-12oz Costco sirloin — seared then finished in oven at 300° to 125° internal
Half cup jasmine rice with olive oil and Kinder's garlic butter herb
Full fat Greek yogurt with fresh blueberries and local honey
Fleur de sel to finish

One gallon of water every single day. Non-negotiable.
The math is simple. 2,000 calories going in. More than that going out. Thermodynamics. Not a diet. Not a program. Just math.
